mapper.insert: INSERT INTO brick_test_suite_run ( suite_id, status, business_status, operator, total_flows, success_flows, failed_flows, business_passed_flows, business_failed_flows, business_not_configured_flows, business_not_evaluated_flows, duration_ms, start_time, error_msg ) VALUES ( #{suiteId}, #{status}, #{businessStatus}, #{operator}, #{totalFlows}, #{successFlows}, #{failedFlows}, #{businessPassedFlows}, #{businessFailedFlows}, #{businessNotConfiguredFlows}, #{businessNotEvaluatedFlows}, #{durationMs}, #{startTime}, #{errorMsg} )
mapper.update: UPDATE brick_test_suite_run SET status = #{status}, business_status = #{businessStatus}, total_flows = #{totalFlows}, success_flows = #{successFlows}, failed_flows = #{failedFlows}, business_passed_flows = #{businessPassedFlows}, business_failed_flows = #{businessFailedFlows}, business_not_configured_flows = #{businessNotConfiguredFlows}, business_not_evaluated_flows = #{businessNotEvaluatedFlows}, duration_ms = #{durationMs}, end_time = #{endTime}, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.suite_id AS suiteId, s.name AS suiteName, s.swagger_mapping_id AS swaggerMappingId, r.status, r.business_status AS businessStatus, r.operator, r.total_flows AS totalFlows, r.success_flows AS successFlows, r.failed_flows AS failedFlows, r.business_passed_flows AS businessPassedFlows, r.business_failed_flows AS businessFailedFlows, r.business_not_configured_flows AS businessNotConfiguredFlows, r.business_not_evaluated_flows AS businessNotEvaluatedFlows, r.duration_ms AS durationMs, r.start_time AS startTime, r.end_time AS endTime, r.error_msg AS errorMsg FROM brick_test_suite_run r INNER JOIN brick_test_suite s ON s.id = r.suite_id WHERE s.is_deleted = 0 AND r.suite_id = #{testSuiteId} AND s.swagger_mapping_id = #{swaggerMappingId} AND s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{suiteName}, '%') AND r.status = #{status} AND r.start_time >= #{startDate} AND r.start_time <= #{endDate} ORDER BY r.start_time DESC, r.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
